Definition: Jepheth, a son of Noah; also his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Japheth is a son of Noah, and the father of the peoples who spread north and west after the flood. In Genesis 5:32, Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth. The fuller story is told on the Japheth profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Japheth belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
